title: M192 R1 — the Rank-1 information budget: provisional verdict and what round 2 adds
summary: Provisional verdict: INCONCLUSIVE. R_GLADE is undefined at the registered priors because the Fisher matrix plus priors is not positive definite along (h, κ). A post-hoc check gives R ≈ 2.7 (line 1.30), so population dominance is indicated, not established. GLADE+ today: σ_h 6.9 %, all of it population information; 20 spectroscopic hosts give 0.5 %, population-free. Skip a question and my suggested answer applies.

questions.text: Q1 [RULE] C-10: approve the derivation docs/derivations/rank1_information_budget.md (model, references, dimensional analysis, five limiting cases, tests)? Until you do, every budget number is provisional. Skip it and my suggested answer applies.

chips.label: Approve the derivation
chips.consequence: The ledger row becomes APPROVED; the numbers lose 'provisional', and the verdict stays INCONCLUSIVE as registered.

chips.label: Approve with changes
chips.consequence: Name them in free text; a round-2 amendment file re-derives and re-runs; the current read stays on record.

chips.label: Do not approve
chips.consequence: The budget stays a draft; no number from it enters the paper or the vault.

questions.text: Q2 [RULE] Beside the named empty-catalogue control, what does round 2 add: the expected-Fisher fix plus the joint hierarchical likelihood (turns INCONCLUSIVE into a number), or Rank 2, the reverse problem (weak at GLADE+/LSST depth here)? Skip it and my suggested answer applies.

chips.label: Expected Fisher + joint likelihood
chips.consequence: Round 2 registers an expected-Fisher read of R_GLADE, then the joint likelihood; the empty-catalogue control runs beside it.

chips.label: Rank 2, the reverse problem
chips.consequence: Round 2 forecasts the BH–galaxy relation from EMRI hosts; R_GLADE stays INCONCLUSIVE for now.

chips.label: Rank 3, golden-event follow-up
chips.consequence: Round 2 costs spectroscopy for the best events (0.5 % from 20 here); R_GLADE stays INCONCLUSIVE.
